KI_Sonstige: The ADM systems that we explore include the Allegheny Family Screening Tool (AFST), Correctional Offender Management Profiling for Alternative Sanctions (COMPAS), and the Australian National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS).
Soziale_Arbeit: This article explores the ways that algorithmic decision-making has become increasingly embedded in social work practice.
Bias_Ungleichheit: ADM systems were designed as ways to reduce bias in decision-making. However, they have been found to accentuate or introduce new biases (Eubanks, 2018; Pasquale, 2017).

analysis.AN_Notes: Conceptual article on the presence/mediation and technique/critique tensions of algorithmic decision-making in social work, worked through case studies (AFST, COMPAS, NDIS, HEALER, Heat List) and a proposal for a practice-embedded critical-technical pedagogy. Bias axes from the case studies: race (COMPAS error rates, over-policing of African-American communities through Heat List) and disability (practitioner bias toward children with disability, NDIS scores overlooking the impact of disability); misogyny and heterosexism appear only in an enumeration, so gender is no object. Harms: unequal false-negative rates (Disparate_Performance) and risk scores from invalid correlations and assumed group characteristics or network proximity (Indirect_Discrimination). Mitigation: organisational and educational measures (mandatory human screening of high scores, algorithmic literacy, case-study pedagogy); Demonstrated because the authors use the case-study method in their own teaching and report student reasoning, without an assessment. Theory: critical theories of social power and technology, sociology of science and technology, critical race theory in the pedagogy; borderline because they frame the curriculum more than a definition of bias.

analysis.AN_Notes: Qualitative interview study (reflexive thematic analysis) with 19 users of generative AI chatbots (mainly Pi and ChatGPT) for mental health; themes emotional sanctuary, insightful guidance, joy of connection, AI therapist. Inequality appears only as unequal reach: the well-educated, tech-savvy sample suggests the benefits may not reach the full population in need; coded Exclusionary_Norms (assumption of digitally skilled users) with the proposed digital-navigator role as organisational remedy. Digital skill is no social axis under the codebook, so AN_Bias_Axes None; bias in the sense of discrimination is no object, hence AN_Bias_Definition Not_Applicable.
